newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Motors to make engines for Hyundai--paper.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Motors to make engines for Hyundai--paper.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp will supply Hyundai Motor Co Ltd with low-emission gasoline direct injection (GDI) engines for passenger cars, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday.
Mitsubishi will supply 10,000 to 20,000 of its 4,500 cc GDI engines annually to Hyundai, which will use them in its high-end passenger cars, the paper said.
The Japanese car maker will also provide Hyundai with diesel engine technology for trucks, the paper added.
Mitsubishi's move is expected to help Hyundai boost its vehicles' competitiveness, the paper said.
Mitsubishi could not immediately confirm the report.
